recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast studio portrait of a male vocalist positioned on the right, set against a vibrant teal-to-green gradient background with bold, left-aligned sans-serif typography in white and yellow.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject offset to the right creates a large negative space for typography on the left.
The yellow of the top text line echoes the warm tones of the subject's sweater.
The teal background provides a cool contrast to the warm skin tones and orange-yellow knitwear.
coreInvariants: Solid teal/cyan background with subtle vignetting
Subject in a three-quarter view looking toward the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium close-up, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, slightly angled toward the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white block lettering of the name.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright yellow title at the top left, moves down through the white name, then across to the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left side, utilized for track listings and branding.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal/Cyan background providing a cool, saturated base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for primary name text to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mustard yellow for the title and sweater, creating a warm-cool color harmony.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high-value white text for a punchy, commercial look.

letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning to create a solid block of text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same sans-serif family for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, mid-century American grotesque feel.
Provides the geometric purity seen in the title numbers.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with 1960s styled hair, wearing a black turtleneck and a mustard-yellow knit sweater draped over his shoulder. The background should be a vibrant teal-to-green gradient with soft lighting. Position the man on the right side of the frame, leaving the left side as open negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top left corner. Use yellow for the top line and white for the larger name below it. Add a small list of song titles in a smaller, bold yellow sans-serif font further down the left side.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated teal gradient?
Is the subject positioned to the right?
Are the colors white, yellow, and teal dominant?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the teal background has a smooth gradient.
Check that the yellow text is legible against the teal.
Verify the subject's pose feels natural and mid-century in style.
Confirm the typography does not overlap the subject's face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Saturated Gradient Background + Left-Aligned Bold Sans-Serif Typography + Primary/Secondary Color Contrast
